description: This source file defines a 'Hooks' class containing setup and teardown methods for test scenarios in a C# automation testing framework, integrating Selenium WebDriver (via DriverFactory), Allure reporting, and test scenario context handling.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: A class providing setup and teardown hooks for test scenarios, including taking screenshots on failure and attaching them to Allure reports.

methods.name: BeforeScenario
methods.description: Method to execute before each test scenario, initializes the WebDriver.

methods.name: AfterScenario
methods.description: Method to execute after each test scenario, captures a screenshot if the scenario failed and attaches it to the Allure report, then quits the driver.

methods.name: TryAddAllureAttachment
methods.description: Private helper method to attach files to Allure reports, with error handling to avoid masking original test failures.
